description: Check a SQL statement without running it. Parses it with QSYS2.PARSE_STATEMENT and checks that referenced tables, columns, and qualified routines exist in the catalog. Also reports read-only and schema-allowlist findings.

sql.description: SQL statement to validate. It is not executed.

name: validate_query

cause.description: Why the statement failed. &1-style placeholders stand for values in error.

recovery.description: What to change before trying again

skippedFilters.description: Annotated tables whose row filter, such as leaving out deleted rows, the query does not use. See warnings

sqlcode.description: SQLCODE of the failed statement, such as -204

title: Validate SQL Query
